item.title: SUGIFT Recalls SUGIFT Pressure Washers Due to Serious Risk of Injury or Death from Shock and Electrocution Hazards
item.company: Online at bestbuy.com from July 2025 through July 2026 for about $155.
item.brand: Online at bestbuy.com from July 2025 through July 2026 for about $155.
item.product: SUGIFT Electric Pressure Washers, Model LTBBHG006
item.summary: This recall involves SUGIFT-branded pressure washers. The recalled, 2.8 GPM electric pressure washers are orange and black, and measure about 11.4 inches deep, 12.7 inches wide and 25.2 inches high. The pressure washers come with a touch screen, foam cannon, four quick disconnect nozzles, a 20-foot hose and two rollers. Labeling on the front of the pressure washer reads "High Pressure Washer". The model number LTBBHG006 does not appear on the product but it was included in the Best Buy website listing.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: SUGIFT Electric Pressure Washers, Model LTBBHG006.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled pressure washers immediately and contact SUGIFT for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the pressure washer by cutting the power cord in half (the product should be completely turned off and unplugged from power outlet) and send a photo of the destroyed pressure washer to steven@sugift.net. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
